code.description: Stable numeric Telnyx error catalog id. See `meta.url` for the full catalog entry.

detail.description: Context-specific message describing what went wrong on this particular request. May embed offending values; do not rely on it for programmatic matching - branch on `code`.

meta.description: Carries `url` linking to the Telnyx error catalog entry for this `code`. Useful for forwarding the user to documentation.

title.description: Short human-readable category, e.g. `Bad Request`, `Duplicate resource`, `Not Found`, `Forbidden`. Treat as advisory only - the stable identifier is `code`.

branded-calling_Errors.description: Canonical Telnyx error envelope. Returned on every 4xx and 5xx response from this service. `errors` is non-empty; multiple entries indicate multiple distinct problems with the same request (e.g. one entry per invalid phone number on a bulk operation).

post.description:
Email a 6-digit code to the DIR's authorizer email to confirm ownership of that address. The code goes to the authorizer, not to the caller. If the authorizer is someone else (for example a client's executive), that person has to share the code with whoever is completing setup.

How long the code lasts: 15 minutes by default. 8 hours when the DIR has a call center (BPO) linked through `bpo_authorizations` whose authorization is pending review or approved (a rejected authorization does not count). Link the call center before you send the code: a code sent before the link keeps the 15-minute window, and a code sent after the link lasts 8 hours. The email states the window, and `expires_at` in the response always shows the exact expiry.

To resend, call this endpoint again. Each send issues a fresh code and invalidates the previous one. Sends are limited to one every 60 seconds and 10 per DIR per UTC day. A throttled send returns `429` with `retry_after_secs` and `sends_remaining_today` in the error `meta`.

Submit the code to `POST /dir/{dir_id}/verify_email/confirm`.

200.description: A code was emailed; the current verification state is returned.

post.description:
Submit the 6-digit code that was emailed to the DIR's authorizer email. On success the authorizer email is marked verified.

For security, any failure (wrong, expired, already-used, or too many attempts) returns the same generic message.

Email a 6-digit code to the enterprise account's contact email to confirm ownership of that address.

A BPO (Business Process Outsourcer) account has no DIR, so it proves ownership of its own contact email here rather than through a DIR. A BPO account cannot be approved for use until this contact email is verified.

The code expires in 15 minutes. Requesting a new code invalidates any previous one. Resends are rate limited (a short cooldown plus a daily cap). Submit the code to `POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/verify_email/confirm`.
